courses.title: Usability Testing for Product Teams
courses.description: Usability Testing for Product Teams takes you from the basics of usability testing to applying it on a realistic Product Designer scenario, through short lessons and hands-on practice. Along the way, you'll also get a practical introduction to cross-functional collaboration, enough to use it alongside usability testing day to day. Expect a practical course, not a lecture-heavy one.
learning_outcomes: Applying usability testing to a real Product Designer scenario
Practicing usability testing through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to cross-functional collaboration
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: User Research for Practitioners
courses.description: User Research for Practitioners is a focused course on user research for people already working toward a Product Designer role who want to go further. You'll work through applied exercises that push past the basics and into more realistic scenarios, with less hand-holding than an introductory course. By the end, you should feel noticeably more confident applying user research on your own.
learning_outcomes: Applying user research to a real Product Designer scenario
Practicing user research through guided exercises
Building a short user research exercise from scratch
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Accessibility Auditing Basics
courses.description: Accessibility Auditing Basics is a short introduction to accessibility auditing for people moving toward a Product Designer role. You'll walk through the essential vocabulary and a few guided exercises that show accessibility auditing in context, with no prior experience assumed. The pace is gentle, with short lessons rather than a heavy project. It's a reasonable starting point if accessibility auditing is new to you.

alternates.title: Usability Testing Essentials
alternates.description: Usability Testing Essentials walks you through the basics of usability testing, built for people new to Product Designer work. Starting from the essential vocabulary, you'll work through a handful of guided exercises that build a working sense of usability testing, with no prior experience assumed. Expect short, practical lessons rather than a long project, with just enough depth to get you started.
learning_outcomes: Applying usability testing to a real Product Designer scenario
Practicing usability testing through guided exercises
Building a short usability testing exercise from scratch
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

alternates.title: Advanced Usability Testing Techniques
alternates.description: Advanced Usability Testing Techniques goes beyond the basics of usability testing, for people already working toward a Product Designer role. Through a handful of applied exercises and more realistic scenarios, you'll build the kind of judgement that only comes with practice, rather than following a fixed recipe. It's built for people who already have some grounding in usability testing and want to go further.
learning_outcomes: Applying usability testing to a real Product Designer scenario
Practicing usability testing through guided exercises
Building a short usability testing exercise from scratch
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them
